branch.name: Finance
branch.summary: Market data (stock quotes, price history, fundamentals, options, news), currency exchange and crypto prices, plus business finance: Stripe payments/billing and QuickBooks accounting and expenses.

toolkits.name: Alpha Vantage
toolkits.summary: Realtime and historical equity, forex and crypto market data, company fundamentals and news sentiment from Alpha Vantage.

tools.name: global_quote
tools.description: Returns the latest price and volume information for a ticker of your choice.

symbol.description: The symbol of the global ticker of your choice. For example: symbol=IBM.

tools.name: time_series_daily
tools.description: Returns raw (as-traded) daily time series (date, daily open, daily high, daily low, daily close, daily volume) of the global equity specified, covering 20+ years of historical data.

symbol.description: The name of the equity of your choice. For example: symbol=IBM.

outputsize.description: compact returns only the latest 100 data points; full returns the full-length time series of 20+ years of historical data.

tools.name: time_series_intraday
tools.description: Returns current and 20+ years of historical intraday OHLCV time series of the equity specified, covering pre-market and post-market hours where applicable.

symbol.description: The name of the equity of your choice. For example: symbol=IBM.

interval.description: Time interval between two consecutive data points in the time series.

adjusted.description: By default output is adjusted by historical split and dividend events. Set false to query raw (as-traded) intraday values.

extended_hours.description: Include pre-market and post-market trading hours.

month.description: Query a specific month in history, in YYYY-MM format, e.g. 2009-01.

outputsize.description: compact (latest 100 points) or full (30 days, or the full requested month).

tools.name: company_overview
tools.description: Returns the company information, financial ratios, and other key metrics for the equity specified. Data is generally refreshed on the same day a company reports its latest earnings and financials.

symbol.description: The symbol of the ticker of your choice. For example: symbol=IBM.

tools.name: symbol_search
tools.description: Returns the best-matching symbols and market information based on keywords of your choice.

keywords.description: A text string of your choice. For example: keywords=microsoft.

tools.name: currency_exchange_rate
tools.description: Returns the realtime exchange rate for any pair of digital currency (e.g., Bitcoin) or physical currency (e.g., USD).

from_currency.description: The currency you would like to get the exchange rate for. It can either be a physical currency or digital/crypto currency. For example: USD or BTC.

to_currency.description: The destination currency for the exchange rate. For example: USD or BTC.

tools.name: news_sentiment
tools.description: Returns live and historical market news & sentiment data from a large and growing selection of premier news outlets around the world, covering stocks, cryptocurrencies, forex, and a wide range of topics such as fiscal policy, mergers & acquisitions and IPOs. Each article comes with an overall sentiment score and label (Bearish, Somewhat-Bearish, Neutral, Somewhat-Bullish, Bullish) plus per-ticker relevance and sentiment scores. Use the tickers and topics filters to narrow results; with no filters the latest articles across all markets are returned.

tickers.description: Comma-separated stock/crypto/forex symbols, e.g. 'IBM' or 'COIN,CRYPTO:BTC,FOREX:USD'. Returned articles mention ALL listed tickers.

time_from.description: Start of the time range in YYYYMMDDTHHMM format, e.g. 20220410T0130.

time_to.description: End of the time range in YYYYMMDDTHHMM format. Defaults to now.

limit.description: Maximum number of articles to return.

toolkits.name: Yahoo Finance
toolkits.summary: Stock prices, company info, financial statements, options, corporate actions, analyst recommendations and news via yfinance.

tools.name: get_historical_stock_prices
tools.description: Get historical stock prices for a given ticker symbol from yahoo finance. Include the following information: Date, Open, High, Low, Close, Volume, Adj Close.

ticker.description: The ticker symbol of the stock to get historical prices for, e.g. "AAPL"

period.description: Valid periods: 1d,5d,1mo,3mo,6mo,1y,2y,5y,10y,ytd,max. Either use period parameter or use start and end.

interval.description: Valid intervals: 1m,2m,5m,15m,30m,60m,90m,1h,1d,5d,1wk,1mo,3mo. Intraday data cannot extend past the last 60 days.

tools.name: get_stock_info
tools.description: Get stock information for a given ticker symbol from yahoo finance. Include the following information: Stock Price & Trading Info, Company Information, Financial Metrics, Earnings & Revenue, Margins & Returns, Dividends, Balance Sheet, Ownership, Analyst Coverage, Risk Metrics, Other.

ticker.description: The ticker symbol of the stock to get information for, e.g. "AAPL"

tools.name: get_yahoo_finance_news
tools.description: Get news for a given ticker symbol from yahoo finance.

ticker.description: The ticker symbol of the stock to get news for, e.g. "AAPL"

tools.name: get_stock_actions
tools.description: Get stock dividends and stock splits for a given ticker symbol from yahoo finance.

ticker.description: The ticker symbol of the stock to get stock actions for, e.g. "AAPL"

tools.name: get_financial_statement
tools.description: Get financial statement for a given ticker symbol from yahoo finance. You can choose from the following financial statement types: income_stmt, quarterly_income_stmt, balance_sheet, quarterly_balance_sheet, cashflow, quarterly_cashflow.

ticker.description: The ticker symbol of the stock to get financial statement for, e.g. "AAPL"

financial_type.description: The type of financial statement to get.

tools.name: get_option_chain
tools.description: Fetch the option chain for a given ticker symbol, expiration date, and option type.

ticker.description: The ticker symbol of the stock to get option chain for, e.g. "AAPL"

expiration_date.description: The expiration date for the options chain (format: 'YYYY-MM-DD')

option_type.description: The type of option to fetch ('calls' or 'puts')

tools.name: get_recommendations
tools.description: Get recommendations or upgrades/downgrades for a given ticker symbol from yahoo finance. You can also specify the number of months back to get upgrades/downgrades for, default is 12.

ticker.description: The ticker symbol of the stock, e.g. "AAPL"

recommendation_type.description: The type of recommendation to get.

months_back.description: Number of months back to get upgrades/downgrades for.

toolkits.name: CoinGecko
toolkits.summary: Cryptocurrency prices, market rankings, historical charts and trending coins from the CoinGecko API.

tools.name: get_simple_price
tools.description: Query the prices of one or more coins by using their unique Coin API IDs.

ids.description: Coins' IDs, comma-separated if querying more than 1 coin, e.g. bitcoin,ethereum. Refers to /coins/list.

vs_currencies.description: Target currency of coins, comma-separated if querying more than 1 currency, e.g. usd,eur.

include_last_updated_at.description: Include last updated price time in UNIX.

precision.description: Decimal place for currency price value.

tools.name: get_coins_markets
tools.description: Query all the supported coins with price, market cap, volume and market related data.

vs_currency.description: Target currency of coins and market data, e.g. usd.

ids.description: Coins' IDs, comma-separated if querying more than 1 coin.

category.description: Filter based on coins' category, e.g. layer-1, meme-token.

price_change_percentage.description: Include price change percentage timeframe, comma-separated: 1h, 24h, 7d, 14d, 30d, 200d, 1y.

precision.description: Decimal place for currency price value, 'full' or 0-18.

include_tokens.description: For coins with multiple tokens on different chains.

tools.name: get_coin_market_chart
tools.description: Get the historical chart data of a coin including time in UNIX, price, market cap and 24hrs volume based on particular coin id.

vs_currency.description: Target currency of market data, e.g. usd.

days.description: Data up to number of days ago. Any integer or 'max'.

interval.description: Data interval. Leave empty for auto granularity.

precision.description: Decimal place for currency price value.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search CoinGecko.

tools.name: get_trending
tools.description: Query trending search coins, NFTs and categories on CoinGecko in the last 24 hours.

toolkits.name: Stripe
toolkits.summary: Stripe payments API: customers, invoices, payment links, payment intents, refunds, subscriptions, disputes and balance.

tools.name: create_customer
tools.description: This tool will create a customer in Stripe.

tools.name: list_customers
tools.description: This tool will fetch a list of Customers from Stripe.

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100.

email.description: A case-sensitive filter on the list based on the customer's email field. The value must be a string.

tools.name: create_payment_link
tools.description: This tool will create a payment link in Stripe.

price.description: The ID of the price to create the payment link for.

quantity.description: The quantity of the product to include.

redirect_url.description: The URL the customer will be redirected to after the purchase is complete.

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: This tool will create an invoice in Stripe.

customer.description: The ID of the customer to create the invoice for.

days_until_due.description: The number of days until the invoice is due.

tools.name: create_invoice_item
tools.description: This tool will create an invoice item in Stripe.

customer.description: The ID of the customer to create the invoice item for.

price.description: The ID of the price for the item.

invoice.description: The ID of the invoice to create the item for.

tools.name: finalize_invoice
tools.description: This tool will finalize an invoice in Stripe.

invoice.description: The ID of the invoice to finalize.

tools.name: retrieve_balance
tools.description: This tool will retrieve the balance from Stripe. It takes no input.

tools.name: create_refund
tools.description: This tool will refund a payment intent in Stripe.

payment_intent.description: The ID of the PaymentIntent to refund.

amount.description: The amount to refund in cents. Defaults to the full remaining amount.

reason.description: String indicating the reason for the refund.

tools.name: list_payment_intents
tools.description: This tool will list payment intents in Stripe.

customer.description: The ID of the customer to list payment intents for.

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100.

tools.name: list_subscriptions
tools.description: This tool will list all subscriptions in Stripe.

customer.description: The ID of the customer to list subscriptions for.

price.description: The ID of the price to list subscriptions for.

status.description: The status of the subscriptions to retrieve.

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100.

tools.name: cancel_subscription
tools.description: This tool will cancel a subscription in Stripe.

subscription.description: The ID of the subscription to cancel.

invoice_now.description: Will generate a final invoice that invoices for any un-invoiced metered usage and new/pending proration invoice items.

prorate.description: Will generate a proration invoice item that credits remaining unused time until the subscription period end.

comment.description: Additional comments about why the user canceled the subscription.

feedback.description: The customer submitted reason for why they canceled.

tools.name: update_subscription
tools.description: This tool will update an existing subscription in Stripe. If changing an existing subscription item, the existing subscription item has to be set to deleted and the new one has to be added.

subscription.description: The ID of the subscription to update.

proration_behavior.description: Determines how to handle prorations when the subscription items change.

id.description: The ID of the subscription item to modify.

price.description: The ID of the price to switch to.

items.description: A list of subscription items to update, add, or remove.

cancel_at_period_end.description: Whether to cancel the subscription at the end of the current period.

trial_end.description: Unix timestamp representing the end of the trial period, or 'now'.

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to the subscription.

tools.name: list_disputes
tools.description: This tool will fetch a list of disputes in Stripe.

charge.description: Only return disputes associated to the charge specified by this charge ID.

payment_intent.description: Only return disputes associated to the PaymentIntent specified by this PaymentIntent ID.

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100.

toolkits.name: QuickBooks Online
toolkits.summary: Intuit QuickBooks Online accounting: expenses (purchases), bills, vendors, customers, invoices and financial reports.

tools.name: create_purchase
tools.description: Create a purchase (expense) transaction in QuickBooks Online. Use for money spent by cash, check or credit card that is recorded immediately rather than as a bill to pay later.

AccountRef.description: Bank or credit card account the money came out of.
Expense account, e.g. Travel, Meals, Software.

tools.name: search_purchases
tools.description: Search purchases (expenses) using criteria. Returns matching Purchase objects.

field.description: Entity field to filter on, e.g. DisplayName, TxnDate, TotalAmt.

desc.description: Field to sort descending by, e.g. TxnDate.

tools.name: create_bill
tools.description: Create a bill (accounts payable) from a vendor in QuickBooks Online, to be paid later.

tools.name: search_vendors
tools.description: Search vendors

field.description: Entity field to filter on, e.g. DisplayName, TxnDate, TotalAmt.

tools.name: create_customer
tools.description: Create a customer in QuickBooks Online.

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Create an invoice for a customer in QuickBooks Online (accounts receivable).

tools.name: get_profit_and_loss
tools.description: Run the Profit and Loss report (income statement) for the connected QuickBooks company over a date range.

tools.name: get_balance_sheet
tools.description: Balance sheet report.

toolkits.name: Frankfurter FX
toolkits.summary: Foreign exchange reference rates published by the European Central Bank: latest, historical and time series, with amount conversion.

tools.name: get_latest_rates
tools.description: Get the latest working-day exchange rates published by the European Central Bank. Pass amount to convert a sum from the base currency into the target currencies.

symbols.description: Comma-separated target currencies, e.g. USD,GBP. Defaults to all.

amount.description: Amount of base currency to convert.

tools.name: get_historical_rates
tools.description: Get exchange rates for a specific past date (back to 1999-01-04). If the date falls on a weekend or holiday the closest previous working day is returned.

tools.name: get_time_series
tools.description: Get daily exchange rates over a date range.

tools.name: list_currencies
tools.description: List available currencies.
